item_short_desc: Rothco’s 8 x 42 Binoculars are designed to offer high-performance optics, making them ideal for outdoor enthusiasts and nature lovers. With an 8x magnification and a 7.5° field of view, these binoculars allow you to observe distant objects with precision and clarity. The multi-coated lenses ensure optimal light transmission, providing bright and clear images even in low-light conditions. Featuring a 40mm front lens diameter and a 23mm eyepiece diameter, these binoculars are built for durability and comfort.
description: Rothco’s 8 x 42 Binoculars are designed to offer high-performance optics, making them ideal for outdoor enthusiasts and nature lovers. With an 8x magnification and a 7.5° field of view, these binoculars allow you to observe distant objects with precision and clarity. The multi-coated lenses ensure optimal light transmission, providing bright and clear images even in low-light conditions. Featuring a 40mm front lens diameter and a 23mm eyepiece diameter, these binoculars are built for durability and comfort. The diopter adjustment range of -4D to +4D allows you to fine-tune your view, ensuring crystal-clear focus for all users. The binoculars come with a convenient carrying case and lens cloth, making it easy to maintain and transport them. Whether you’re bird watching, hiking, or attending sporting events, Rothco’s 8 x 42 binoculars are the perfect companion for clear, long-range vision and enhanced viewing experiences.
